arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Seth Waxman argued for Chase Bank. He focused on interpreting Regulation Z.
Justice Kagan asked about deference to agency briefs. She cited the Auer standard.
Justice Breyer questioned the meaning of specific language. He challenged a dissent's characterization.
Justice Sotomayor asked about deference to ANPRs. She compared them to amicus briefs.
